title: AKE principles in roughly deeply ramified henselian valued fields
summary: We show that for any henselian valued field of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$, the (existential) $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{val}}$-theory of the valued field is determined by the (existential) theory of the value group in $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{oag}}$ with a constant for $v(p)$ and the (existential) theory of the residue ring $\mathcal{O}_v/(p)$ in an expansion $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Witt}}$ of the language of rings, provided $\mathcal{O}_v/(p)$ is semi perfect. We moreover show that the $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Witt}}$-structure on $\mathcal{O}_v/(p)$ is $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ring}}$-definable using…
